subject: Discovery recap & next steps — observability & evals
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — observability & evals

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Below is a concise recap of what we discussed, the key pain points you shared, success criteria, and proposed next steps so we can align on a POC plan. Please reply with any corrections or additions.

Summary / pain points
- Lack of visibility into prompt-level regressions: your team only surfaces model-level metrics and needs golden prompt sets and regression alerts tied to prompts and prompt families.
- Hard to correlate production prompts with backend traces and user flows — you asked for tracing hooks and per-request metadata to tie evals back to the product UX.
- Cost and latency surprises on peak loads; need per-route dashboards and alerting to detect regressions in token cost and latency.
- Evaluation drift: no consistent golden prompt set to run guardrails on releases, and rollouts lack automated rollback guardrails based on eval regressions.

Current stack
- Backend: Kubernetes on GCP (us-central1) with a mix of server-side prompts and client-side prompting in the app.
- Auth/Security: Google SSO; currently exploring KMS options for key management.
- Observability: Datadog for infra + custom logging; no dedicated prompt-level monitoring today.

Success criteria for a successful POC (your asks)
1) Provide per-route & per-model dashboards that show: latency P50/P95, per-token cost, error rate, and prompt-family regression charts.
2) Tracing hooks + request metadata to correlate prompts -> traces in Datadog.
3) Automated regression alerts (email/Slack) when golden prompt set performance falls below thresholds.
4) Rollout guardrails: canary evaluation and auto-fallback on regression.
5) Clear estimate of cost delta with suggested batching/quantization + expected latency impact.

Requested dashboards/features (you called these out explicitly)
- Prompt family rollup dashboard (by feature area)
- Golden prompt set comparison panel (baseline vs. current)
- Regression alerting that surfaces sample outputs for triage
- Token-cost per route heatmap and cost drivers

Notes / constraints
- Data residency: US only for PHI-sensitive flows.
- Timeline: internal goal is POC approval by end of August.

Attachments: discovery notes + workbook with mappings to prompt families attached (zenhealth-observability-requirements.xlsx). I also uploaded the workbook to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xyz123

Proposed next steps
- Marissa: send MOP + initial mutual action plan by EOD tomorrow (attaching workbook).
- ZenHealth: confirm golden prompt set (top 50 prompts) and a POV owner for the POC (name + email).
- Schedule kickoff: 60–90 minute technical kickoff with Avery (SE) + infra/Datadog owner — proposed windows next week (Mon/Tue afternoon PST).

If this looks right I’ll put together a short mutual action plan and a high-level pricing ballpark for the POC.

Thanks — talk soon.

--

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches my notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Golden prompts: we can surface the top ~60 prompts across our triage flows; Samir will own the selection and upload a CSV by next Tue (7/21).
- Data retention: we need confirmation that prompt text used for evals can be redacted/stored only for 90 days for PHI flows.
- SSO/KMS: we use Google SSO today; for KMS we'd prefer a bring-your-own-key option if possible.
- Timeline: POC by end of August works for us — target kickoff week of 7/27.

Can you also include a ballpark price range for the POC (monthly committed capacity estimate + expected egress/token cost) so I can float it with procurement?

One more ask: can you show an example of the regression alert format (sample payload/email) so our product team understands triage flow?

Appreciate it — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Alex

- Golden prompt set: great — Samir’s CSV by 7/21 works. We’ll build the golden set on our side and map to prompt families in the workbook.
- Data retention: we support configurable retention windows; for PHI flows we can recommend a 90-day retention policy and a redaction flow. I’ll include the retention options in the MOP tomorrow.
- KMS/SSO: BYOK via customer KMS is supported on Private and Dedicated; for hosted we have managed KMS with HSM integrations — I’ll include a short summary of options and the engineering trade-offs.
- Regression alert example: see attached sample alert payload and a screenshot of the Slack/email alert flow (I’ve attached a short PDF).

Mutual action plan (proposed)
1) 7/21 — ZenHealth provides golden prompt CSV (Samir) + POV owner.
2) 7/23 — Redwood to deliver a tailored MOP + workbook mapping (Marissa/Avery).
3) 7/27 — Technical kickoff (Avery + ZenHealth infra + product).
4) 8/10 — Initial dashboard + tracing hooks enabled for seeded routes.
5) 8/24 — Regression alerts + golden prompt eval automation (POC deliverable).

POC pricing (ballpark)
- Estimated committed: 4 dedicated V100-equivalent GPU weeks per month (monthly billing) for the POC.
- Estimated token/egress: depends on sampling; we’ll provide a range in the formal quote but expect the POC to be within a $12k–$18k monthly run-rate depending on sampling and tracing verbosity.

Next steps: I’ll upload the MOP + workbook to the Drive folder and share the HubSpot deal (see link). Can you confirm Samir and the infra owner for the kickoff invite?
